name: print-social-sunset-residential-post-with-title-top-right-and-value-icons
title: Sunset photo of a marble-and-glass residence with a bold caps title top right and four value icons in a dark fade
whatItIs: A portrait photo of a modern white and bronze apartment block at golden hour with 'NOVA PARK' in bold black caps and 'A family-friendly community' at the top right, fading into black at the bottom where four gold line icons (house, globe, key, shield) sit above white caps labels Quality, Transparency, Innovation and Sustainability separated by hairlines.
whatItMeans: Warm and credible; the golden hour photo sells and the icon row states the promise.
techniques: Set dark title text in the bright sky.
Use four gold line icons with hairlines.

vocabulary.definition: A title placed in the sky area.
A gradient darkening the lower edge.
A thin outline icon in gold.
A row of principles with icons.
